content_of_post_to_comment:
I find that TV is now stupid and I don't want to watch it. But I find myself overwhelmed and its hard when tv and youtbe and stuff was used to take the edge of being overhwelmed off.

I do have hobbies. I go birding, read a bunch, diamond painting, coloring, regular painting, journaling, audiobooks, sewing and puzzles. I also play solo board games.

How did you adopt to being overwhelmed? What was your go to? When you wanted to relax and not do anything or to let go of stress and not feel ovewhelmed. I feel like all my hobbies take brain power and sometimes I just need to chill and not use my brain and I don't know how.

I also have chronic pain so sometimes I can't do anything and I just need to distracted in a mindless way. Which is what I use TV and internet for in the past. But now TV seems so stupid and there's nothing to watch.
comment: Maybe the answer is finding something that occupies your attention without requiring you to actively do anything. With chronic pain, even hobbies can feel like work. I’d try familiar comfort shows, nature livestreams, or long videos of people doing ordinary things, like walking through forests or restoring old furniture. You don’t have to find TV interesting; sometimes background company is enough.
